label: Two calibrations preserve every realized grade but reverse a relay's export balance
paraphrase: In a four-bearer transfer tree every giver realizes each of its recipient's selected features. Each bearer's degree is the least upper bound of its realized levels for every high level at least two and fixed low level two. Book each recipient's degree on its incoming edge. A relay's receipts and exports are three and four under high grade three, and five and four under high grade five. The ordinal comparisons between all bearers agree on those two scales. No actual existential amounts are assigned.
